messages:
maria: Quick heads-up — prepping q6b-16k-int4 for canary. Need to carve a dedicated promptset split + refresh golden with synthetic paraphrases before evals.
kevin: How many gold samples are we targeting? current golden 2k, do we need more for 16k context?
anjali: Labeler capacity low this week. If we go manual it'll push to next Tue. Can we synth aug instead?
sasha: FYI tokenizer differences already produced dedupe fingerprint collisions on local run. saw ~3% overlap change.
maria: that's the risk. plan: freeze promptset merges, run synth paraphrase amplification x3, then quick manual spotcheck 300 items.
kevin: fine — what infra for synth gen? small-hosted job or local batch?
oliver: propose running the synth generator on staging-k8s: command:
```
kubectl -n ml-run run synth-gen --image=redwood/synth:latest -- /app/gen --model=q6b-16k-int4 --multiplier 3 --out=/mnt/gold
```

oliver: mount to nfs shared with labelers; will spawn 8 pods.
labeler-bot: New labeling task created: golden-spotcheck-6290012345 (300 items) assigned to @anjali @kevin
anjali: I can take the spotcheck if labeler-bot provisions tasks today. otherwise I'll triage tomorrow morning.
sasha: attaching failing tokenization snippet from eval harness:
```
ERROR: token_map mismatch: expected_len=1024 got=1008
context_id=xyz-729
sample="...\u2060..."
```
kevin: Hmm that invisible char (⁠) keeps breaking dedupe hashing. we should run a normalize pass before fingerprinting.
maria: Agreed. Add normalizer step to pipeline and re-run fingerprint regen. oliver can you add to job?
oliver: done, will run regen with:
```
python tools/fingerprint_regen.py --input=/mnt/gold --normalize=unicode_nfkd --shards=16
```

deploy-bot: Canary deployed q6b-16k-int4 -> staging (tag: canary-6290012345) :rocket:
maria: timeline: synth run + regen today, spotcheck tonight, canary eval tomorrow morning. Freeze merges for 24h starting now. @everyone please ack.
kevin: ack :thumbsup:
anjali: ack, will check spotcheck tonight.
sasha: ack — will run dedupe stats after regen and share numbers.
maria: thanks all — will post eval dashboard link when ready.
